sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Others
Counsel for Revisionist :- M S Haq
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 18.12.1991 passed by Sri Pitambar Singh, Vth Additional Sessions Judge,
Bijnor in Criminal Appeal No.223 of 1985, Abdul Gaffar vs. State of U.P. and another arising out of judgment and order dated 10.9.1985 passed by Sri Janardan Kumar, First Class Special Judicial Magistrate, Nagina, District Bijnor in Case No.465 of 1984, State vs. Abdul Gaffar, convicting appellant under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954") for six months' rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.1,000/-, whereby appeal of appellant was dismissed and conviction and sentence under Section 7/16 of Act, 1954 has been confirmed.
Abdul Gaffar vs State Of U.P.And Others on 10 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126647539/

sentences.text:
3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
6. The accused, Abdul Gaffar is on bail.
His bail bonds and surety bonds are cancelled.
The Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned shall cause him to be arrested and lodge in jail to serve out the sentence passed against him.
The compliance shall be prepared within two months.
7. Certify this judgment to the lower Court immediately.

Order Date :- 10.7.2019 KA  Abdul Gaffar vs State Of U.P.And Others on 10 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126647539/
